[Tests] cache prebuilt deps per react version to fix CI on node < 10

`npm install` on node 7-9 with npm 6.14.18 was dropping `@babel/runtime` from `node_modules` (the install-time peer warning is the smoking gun), and very old node versions never had a chance against modern babel deps. Move the install + `npm run react` + `tests:build` into a build matrix on lts/*, cache `test-build/` and `node_modules/` per react version, and have the test matrix restore that cache and run `tests-only` directly with `skip-install`.
